README.md:
Edit layout.json to rearrange this workspace’s decisions. Keep each named section once. To group sections, replace them in the list with {"display": "stack", "title": "For review", "sections": ["heading", "request"]}. Use columns for a side-by-side group on wide screens. Set cardLayout in client.js to compact or full. Tedix checks approval permissions for each answer. Publish the revision to update this workspace. In server.js, env.TEDIX.connectionsCall can call tools granted through a bound connection.

When asking about a file, include the output id and revisionId in decisionDeck.sources with kind "output". Include its title and, for a particular slide, its one-based slide number. The reader opens that version directly from the question.
